01-intro: Reviewing your website just got easy. Here's a one-minute guide to Eight Review, by Eight Limbs.
02-portal: Step one. Open your review link. Every page we need you to look at is listed in one place.
03-highlight: Step two. Look for the yellow boxes. Yellow means we'd love your eyes on that part of the page.
04-comment: Step three. Press C, or click Comment. Then click any text, and type your note. Your comment box opens right beside it.
05-approve: Step four. Happy with a section? One click on Approve, and it turns green.
06-suggest: Step five. Try our suggested copy. It's written to help people find you online. Keep the coloured words, those are your search keywords. Then use it as is, or make it your own.
07-blank: Step six. For new pages, you'll see the live page next to a blank copy. Just comment on what should go where.
08-outro: That's it! Look for yellow, comment, and approve. We'll take it from there. Questions? Just leave a comment.
